newsitem.title: CHINA: CHUNG HWA SAYS TO RAISE HK$120 MLN.
newsitem.headline: CHUNG HWA SAYS TO RAISE HK$120 MLN.

text.p: Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd said on Sunday it will raise HK$120 million by placing of 80 million new shares at HK$1.54 a share to fund its new food and beverage business venture in China.
The new shares represent approximately 6.56 percent of the total enlarged share capital of the group, Chung Hwa said in a statement.
The offer price is a 9.94 percent discount to Friday's closing price of HK$1.71 per share, the company said.

Some HK$55 million of the HK$120 million will used as capital expenditure for the production and marketing of Apple Sidra, an apple-flavoured carbonated drink from South America, in China. The remaining will be used as general working capital.
Yamaichi International (Hong Kong) Ltd is the placing agent.
